selection_rules: Use only CA Factory jurisdictions with workflow_status 9.00 Complete, release_ready TRUE, parity_ok TRUE, and geography_gate_ok TRUE.
Exclude control rows so the wave measures ordinary production portability.
Bind each target to the exact seven-digit Census place GEOID in Nested Divisions.
Preserve all county, state-senate, and state-assembly nesting relationships as lists.
Use exact maintained OCD division selectors; canonical aliases are permitted only when explicitly recorded upstream.
Select 20 targets spanning multiple counties and office templates without changing generic engine behavior.
notes: NAT-FAC-002 California scale evidence. The wave expands the NAT-FAC-001 five-target portability smoke to 20 governed release-ready places while preserving the same two-run acceptance contract.
